set.body:
Source: PRD section 13 diagnosis, acceptance criterion for combined evidence confidence, and Q-01/Q-02.

Scope:
- Add a pure core Assessment algebra with confirmed, suspected, and undetermined outcomes.
- Combine submission, observation, accounting, worker, structured-result, and log evidence with explicit authority ordering.
- Add bounded byte-range recognizers for common opaque Python/R/runtime failure hints.
- Ensure log hints remain suspected and never override stronger scheduler, accounting, worker, or result evidence.
- Document the authority and privacy boundaries.

Acceptance:
- Accounting/worker/result evidence can confirm typed causes; stale or unavailable observations cannot fabricate confirmation.
- Log recognition consumes an already bounded page, caps hint count and excerpt bytes, and retains exact byte ranges.
- Conflicts retain contributing causes and evidence deterministically.
- Focused and full Scala 3.7.4 gates pass.
set.title: P6b: Add evidence-ranked failure diagnosis
